messages:
alex_ryan: Quick sync — onboarding `atlas-30b-v2`. Posting checklist and quirks I hit.

maria_k: thanks, drop the paths and config pls

alex_ryan: weights in s3://redwood-models/atlas/30b/v2/manifest.json
 tokenizer files in same bucket under tokenizer/*

jonathan_s: FYI tokenizer has emoji normalization off by default, saw splitting on ZWJ sequences

sara_ops: @jonathan_s can you paste a repro snippet?

jonathan_s: sure — sample python:

```py
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer/tokenizer.json')
print(t.encode('👩‍⚗️').tokens)
```

alex_ryan: config we used for serve: ```json
{"attn_impl":"flash","rope_scale":1.12,"gqa_shards":2,"sliding_window_kv":true}
```

liz_dev: note — runtime currently expects rope_scale <= 1.1 on our cuda12 images, 1.12 triggered incorrect rotary offsets in a canary

deploy-bot: deploy canary atlas-30b-v2 to us-west-2/gpu-pool-13 started by liz_dev

maria_k: can we set rope_scale to 1.0 for canary and run grad-checks? want to avoid silent drift

alex_ryan: done. updated config and kicked off smoke. also enabled kv-prefetch=false to test sliding-window path

sara_ops: logs after start (snippet):
`WARN runtime.attn: KRotation mismatch, falling back to slower kernel` 

liz_dev: that's the kernel fallback we expect — need perf test but correctness preserved

maria_k: QA checklist for this thread:
- validate manifest checksum
- tokenizer emoji/QM splitting test
- rope scale cap in runtime
- gqa shard count sanity
- sliding-window kv TTL test

alex_ryan: I'll add a small CI job to run tokenizer matrix + unit that asserts decode(encode(x))==x for sample set

jonathan_s: ping me when CI is up, I'll add the ZWJ edgecases

sara_ops: adding oncall @sara_ops in case canary errors — will rollback if 5xx spike

liz_dev: thanks everyone. will follow up with perf numbers in #eng-runtime later :thumbsup:
